title: Contracted-Bound 16-Layer Stack Around Top-3 Median Thicknesses
scientific_hypothesis: The top-performing candidates from route_01 exhibit a semi-periodic thickness pattern that, if exploited with narrowed optimization bounds centered on explicit median thickness values, will yield higher target scores by focusing search on promising regions of parameter space rather than exploring unproductive thickness combinations.
design_principle: Tiered thickness contraction: use explicit median thickness per layer position computed from top-3 candidates by target_score from route_01, then optimize within ±15% bounds around these medians to refine the emerging structure while maintaining manufacturability.
proposed_topology: Air | (HfO2 | SiO2) x 8 | Fused Silica substrate; exactly 16 finite layers total, alternating high-index HfO2 and low-index SiO2 starting with HfO2 at air interface.
soft_objectives: maximize mean transmittance in 1000-1700 nm band
maximize mean reflectance in 300-450 nm band
manufacturing_considerations: thickness bounds derived from route_01 top candidates ensure manufacturable thicknesses
alternating HfO2/SiO2 sequence compatible with standard deposition processes
theory_basis: Transfer matrix method for plane-wave propagation through layered media
Local optimization convergence improves when initialized near promising regions
expected_advantages: Exploits structure already discovered in route_01
Maintains same layer count for direct comparison
known_risks: May converge to local optimum if median structure is suboptimal
±15% bounds may be too restrictive if true optimum lies outside
execution_request_english: Optimize a 16-layer alternating HfO2/SiO2 stack on fused silica substrate with air incidence. Layer sequence: HfO2(1), SiO2(2), HfO2(3), SiO2(4), HfO2(5), SiO2(6), HfO2(7), SiO2(8), HfO2(9), SiO2(10), HfO2(11), SiO2(12), HfO2(13), SiO2(14), HfO2(15), SiO2(16). Initialize optimization with median thickness values per layer: layer_1=116.0 nm, layer_2=87.33 nm, layer_3=135.37 nm, layer_4=180.0 nm, layer_5=123.37 nm, layer_6=74.66 nm, layer_7=108.75 nm, layer_8=90.0 nm, layer_9=131.0 nm, layer_10=101.15 nm, layer_11=127.06 nm, layer_12=126.07 nm, layer_13=116.12 nm, layer_14=76.42 nm, layer_15=164.60 nm, layer_16=85.0 nm. Set optimization bounds for each layer thickness to median value ± 15%. Optimize all 16 thicknesses simultaneously to maximize transmission in 1000-1700 nm and reflection in 300-450 nm. Use gradient-based or differential evolution optimizer with sufficient iterations to converge within contracted bounds. Canonical user controls: wavelength intervals 300-450 nm, 1000-1700 nm. soft objectives: high transmission in 1000-1700 nm; high reflection in 300-450 nm. behaviors to suppress or avoid: reflection in 1000-1700 nm; transmission in 300-450 nm. manufacturing constraints: total layer count <= 30.
revision_reason: Applies feedback directive for tiered thickness contraction around route_01 top-3 candidate medians with ±15% bounds to exploit emerging semi-periodic structure. Repaired to include explicit median thickness values instead of cross-route reference.
